_comment: SPDX licences for packages whose UPSTREAM metadata genuinely omits them, so no
scanner can resolve them. Consumed by .github/scripts/normalize-sbom.jq, which
injects these into the CycloneDX BOM before it is uploaded to Dependency-Track.
Keys are exact PURLs (qualifiers ignored). Matching on the exact version is
deliberate: on a version bump the override stops applying and the
'No License Metadata' warning returns, prompting a fresh check rather than
silently carrying an old assertion forward.
Every entry records where the licence was verified. Do not add an entry without

pkg:gem/fast-polylines@2.2.0.note: Gemfile.lock carries no licence data and CI does not run bundle install, so no gemspec exists on disk to read.

pkg:npm/polyline@0.2.0.note: Publishes no 'license' field on npm at any version. Upstream LICENSE is a 3-clause BSD (Development Seed). Package is deprecated in favour of @mapbox/polyline, which also omits the field.
